name: momentum-terminal
description: US equities 12-1 momentum research & internal paper simulation (local only)

scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/py.mjs -m app serve
scripts.test: node scripts/py.mjs -m pytest && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.gen:api: node scripts/py.mjs -m app export-openapi ../frontend/src/api/openapi.json && npm --prefix frontend run gen:api
